Package com.longbridge.asset

Class RewardRecord

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.longbridge.asset.RewardRecord
  • public class RewardRecord
extends Object
    A reward record from the reward center. Prize redemption secrets (coupon_secret), cash card codes (cash_card_code) and shipping contact details are not modelled.
